card.name: RAS gene and mutation terms
card.fires_on: The word Ras or RAS (often split as R + as) and the words right after it, such as mutant, mutation or active, in cancer-drug labels. It also fires on the letters inside Ras.

modes.label: Inside Ras
modes.description: The letters of Ras or RAS as the gene name is spelled out, mostly split after the R.

modes.label: After Ras
modes.description: Words that follow Ras and describe its mutation or activation status.
